issues.description: notes.md references patch file '0001-harmonyos-platform-support.patch' which was deleted and replaced with two separate patches (0001-config.guess.patch and 0002-config.sub.patch). The conandata.yml and manifest.yaml correctly reference the new patch files, but notes.md still documents the old combined patch name, creating an inconsistency that could confuse reviewers.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the '### 补丁' section in notes.md to list the actual patch files: '1. 0001-config.guess.patch: Add HarmonyOS platform detection to config.guess' and '2. 0002-config.sub.patch: Add HarmonyOS platform support to config.sub'.

issues.description: The package() method hardcodes make targets 'install-h install-lib install-pc install-config install-drill install-examples' regardless of the with_drill and with_examples options. If a consumer sets with_examples=False or with_drill=False, the corresponding install targets (install-drill, install-examples) may not exist in the generated Makefile, causing the package step to fail. The default options (both True) work correctly, but the recipe does not handle its own declared options in package().
issues.fix_suggestion: Conditionally include install-drill and install-examples targets based on self.options.with_drill and self.options.with_examples. For example: targets = ['install-h', 'install-lib', 'install-pc', 'install-config']; if self.options.with_drill: targets.append('install-drill'); if self.options.with_examples: targets.append('install-examples'); autotools.make(target=' '.join(targets), args=[f'DESTDIR={self.package_folder}']). Note: autotools Makefiles often retain install targets as no-ops when features are disabled, so this may not fail in practice — verify with the actual ldns Makefile.am structure.

issues.description: The patch_classification entries have guard: 'pending' for both patches (lines 53 and 57). This appears to be an unfinalized placeholder value. Since config.guess and config.sub are shell scripts (not C/C++ code), they do not use preprocessor guards (#ifdef), so the guard field should reflect 'none' or 'N/A' rather than 'pending'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change guard: 'pending' to guard: 'none' for both patch_classification entries, since these patches modify shell scripts (config.guess, config.sub) that do not use C preprocessor guards.

issues.description: The patch_generation section contains local machine-specific absolute paths: source_orig_dir: /storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/ldns-1.9.0.orig and source_work_dir: /storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/ldns-1.9.0.work (lines 42-43). These paths are only valid on the build machine and are not portable. While this is metadata and does not affect the recipe build, it reduces reproducibility documentation quality.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace absolute local paths with relative references or generic placeholders (e.g., 'builds/ldns-1.9.0.orig') or remove the source_orig_dir and source_work_dir fields since the hashes already provide integrity verification.

issues.description: The upstream_check_command field is set to 'make check' (line 9), but the comment on line 16 states 'ldns does not have a standard make check target' and upstream_tests is an empty list. This is contradictory — the check command implies make check exists while the tests list and comment say it does not.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either set upstream_check_command to an empty string "" to match the comment that ldns has no standard make check target, or add a clarifying comment that 'make check' is the standard autotools convention but is not functional for ldns.

summary: Audit of ldns 1.9.0 Conan recipe (feat/ldns-1.9.0 branch, 12 changed files). Verdict: PASS. No P0 (deceptive behavior) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found. All deception checks passed: test_package/test.c calls real ldns API (ldns_rr_list_new, ldns_pkt_new, ldns_version); test_package/conanfile.py test() runs the test binary (no skip/fake pass); sha256 is a valid 64-char hex hash (not placeholder); manifest status=published is consistent with notes.md verification records; no pre-compiled binaries or manual packaging bypass. Recipe correctness verified: Conan 2.x API used correctly, R26 (OpenSSL static via openssl/*:shared=False), R32 (no OS check gaps — HarmonyOS handled via config.guess/config.sub patches), R33 (no bare env vars — uses AutotoolsToolchain), R34 (test calls real API), R39 (URL is official NLnet Labs source), R6 (replace_in_file on configure is acceptable — configure is a source file distributed with the tarball), R37 (first adaptation uses upstream version), R38 (library type, no commands.json needed). Patches are valid unified diff format. conandata.yml and manifest.yaml patch references match actual files. Five minor issues found: 2× P2 (notes.md references deleted patch file; package() hardcodes install targets regardless of options) and 3× P3 (manifest guard field 'pending', local machine paths in manifest, MANIFEST.yml upstream_check_command inconsistency). None are blocking.
